title: More items for furnace
description: Would you like more items to smelt in your furnace so you can smelt more items?
body:
Would you like more items to smelt in your furnace so you can smelt more items? Then this datapack is for you! It adds new smelting items:
all types of coral,
podzol,
mycelium,
grass soil,
dirt,
ore blocks,
seagrass,
a bucket of water,
diamond and netherite tools and armor,
stone tools,
wooden items,
leather armor, and leather.
